modmenu.descriptionTranslation.sypass: A secure Minecraft password manager mod featuring local AES-256-GCM encrypted storage, auto-login, and optional cloud synchronization via the official Bitwarden CLI.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.sypass: In-game password manager with auto-login and optional Bitwarden sync.

sypass.gui.bw.not_found.title: Bitwarden CLI Not Found
sypass.gui.bw.not_found.desc1: The official Bitwarden CLI (bw / bw.exe) was not found on your system PATH or config folder.
sypass.gui.bw.not_found.desc2: Install it via your package manager (winget install Bitwarden.CLI, brew install bitwarden-cli, or npm i -g @bitwarden/cli), or place the 'bw' executable into config/sypass/.
sypass.gui.bw.not_found.desc2.windows: Install via 'winget install Bitwarden.CLI' (or 'npm i -g @bitwarden/cli'), or place 'bw.exe' into config/sypass/.
sypass.gui.bw.not_found.desc2.mac: Install via 'brew install bitwarden-cli' (or 'npm i -g @bitwarden/cli'), or place 'bw' into config/sypass/.
sypass.gui.bw.not_found.desc2.linux: Install via 'sudo snap install bw' (or 'npm i -g @bitwarden/cli'), or place 'bw' into config/sypass/.

sypass.gui.bw.button.open_folder.tooltip: Open the folder where you can place the bw / bw.exe binary manually

sypass.gui.settings.title: SY-Pass Settings
sypass.gui.settings.bw.menu_btn.tooltip: Configure optional Bitwarden CLI cloud synchronization
sypass.gui.settings.bw.title: Bitwarden Integration (Optional)
sypass.gui.settings.bw.desc: Synchronize server passwords across multiple devices using the official Bitwarden CLI.
sypass.gui.settings.enable_bw.tooltip: Enable cloud synchronization with official Bitwarden CLI. When enabled, a Bitwarden tab appears.
sypass.gui.settings.autosync.tooltip: Automatically push/update passwords in Bitwarden on save

sypass.gui.settings.backup.menu_btn.tool: Export, import, and manage local password backups
sypass.gui.settings.backup.title: Local Password Backups:
sypass.gui.settings.backup.desc: Create encrypted or plain backups of your saved passwords to easily transfer them across computers.
sypass.gui.settings.backup.pass_placehol: Encryption password (leave empty for plain backup)...
sypass.gui.settings.backup.pass_tooltip: Enter a password to encrypt backup, or leave empty for easy passwordless import
sypass.gui.settings.backup.pass_required: Backup is password-protected! Enter password above.
sypass.gui.settings.backup.key_mismatch: Encryption key mismatch! Enter password if backup was protected.
sypass.gui.settings.backup.import_failed: Backup file corrupted or invalid format!
sypass.gui.settings.backup.csv_warning: ⚠ Warning: CSV export stores passwords in plaintext! Keep it safe.
sypass.gui.settings.autologin.tooltip: Automatically authenticate on server join and chat prompt
sypass.gui.settings.smart_login.tooltip: Scan server prompts for /login or /l and authenticate instantly
sypass.gui.settings.smart_register.toolt: Automatically generate a strong password and register when a server prompt is detected
sypass.gui.settings.prevent_overwrite.to: Prevent quick/auto-register from overwriting an already saved password for this server
sypass.gui.settings.chat_protect.tooltip: Blocks accidentally sending your saved server password into public chat
sypass.gui.settings.chat_protect.title: 🛡 Chat Leak Protection
sypass.gui.settings.chat_protect.desc: Prevents accidentally sending saved passwords into multiplayer chat.
sypass.gui.settings.chat_scope.title: Validation Scope:
sypass.gui.settings.chat_scope.current_h: Checks only passwords saved for the current server. Passwords from other servers are not blocked.
sypass.gui.settings.chat_scope.all_hint: Scans all passwords in your vault across all servers using Aho-Corasick algorithm. Maximum protection.
sypass.gui.settings.chat_scope.tooltip: Choose whether to check passwords from all servers or only the current server
